rows.gate_summary_zh: 新截图 JPEG 与 native receipt/实际模型请求同 hash；只选择一次；同屏挑战码与 HEPTA_VISUAL_OK 回执相符；真实返回 HEPTA；原 native complete + entire_request business_verified=true。
original_pass_postconditions: Actual local HTTP model request includes the newly captured verified JPEG and its hash matches the bound native result.
Exactly one choice was dispatched; no recapture-to-guess or second challenge attempt is hidden.
Public challenge is literal 挑战码： plus exactly eight uppercase hex characters.
Public receipt is HEPTA_VISUAL_OK plus one space and the same code from the same UI snapshot.
Final actual focus/resumed activity is the fixed HEPTA activity on qualified display 0.
Native terminal is complete and business_verified=true for coverage=entire_request.
rows.title: 一次新截图完成一个全新随机视觉挑战并返回HEPTA

rows.gate_summary_zh: 全新中文、emoji、真实换行及特殊字符输入逐 UTF-8 字节一致；提交一次；编辑器、公开读回及四行公开回执均吻合；真实返回；缺任一条件须 turn.fail。
original_pass_postconditions: Helper operation/package/view/old-text/requested/after hashes and exact UTF8 readback all match.
Public unicode_readback equals the fresh literal input byte for byte.
Public receipt exactly equals the source-defined four-line format in unicode_receipt_formula.
Literal newline remains a newline; XML normalization to a space is a failure, not an allowed rewrite.
Actual HEPTA focus is verified after return.
Input-only success without confirmation, public receipt or return must end as turn.fail/business_verified=false.
rows.title: 全新中文/emoji/换行输入、确认、公开回执与返回

rows.gate_summary_zh: 新随机 (a*b)+c；独立预算期望值；已安装计算器唯一公开结果 view 的实测字符串吻合；按请求真实返回；未知作用不能重复计算。
original_pass_postconditions: Expression and expected result use the fresh parameters, not values from prior examples.
A public visible result proves the arithmetic; a model mental calculation is insufficient.
No repeated evaluation after an uncertain effect.
The exact result contract and requested return both pass.
rows.title: 计算器完成全新随机简单表达式并核验结果

rows.gate_summary_zh: 当前 Settings 包、唯一公开字段、焦点与独立只读系统观察吻合；零设置变更；任务未要求返回时不能强制返回。
original_pass_postconditions: The app field, package, focus and unique view are independently verified.
No settings value, permission, network configuration or account state is changed.
The result is based on actual UI text rather than a prefilled model answer.
No return is forced by generic completion; the contract covers exactly the read-only request.
rows.title: 只读查看设置中的公开系统版本字段

rows.gate_summary_zh: 一次 return_hepta；立即保存 launch rc=0、恰一个 Status: ok 与精确 activity；inner display focus/app/top-resumed 一致且 keyguard=false；仅授予 component 层。
original_pass_postconditions: Launch rc is captured immediately and is zero.
One Status: ok and the exact known activity occur in launch output.
Inner display focus/app/top-resumed all name HEPTA and keyguard is false.
Mark only direct component acceptance, not model or native-task acceptance.
rows.title: 显式返回：launch状态和实际焦点双核验

rows.gate_summary_zh: 新截图后安全切换焦点；待执行 tap 仅一次；guard=70 或明确已知更早前置拒绝；独立前后公开计数证明两页零 input；image 消耗、不重试；本次 closure/late boundary 齐全。
original_pass_postconditions: Guard exits 70 or fails earlier with an explicitly recorded known precondition.
No input effect is observed on either old or new page.
The image is consumed and the effect is not retried.
rows.title: 截图后焦点切换：必须在input之前拒绝

rows.gate_summary_zh: NEG-01 完整结算后新身份；viewport/focus 保持不变、PNG SHA 改变；guard=71 且在 input 前；公开状态/计数无作用、不重试；本次 closure/late boundary 齐全。
original_pass_postconditions: Viewport and focus remain the same, but PNG SHA differs.
Guard exits 71 before input.
No selection/submission/other app effect and no automatic retry occur.
rows.title: 同viewport内容变化：精确像素guard必须拒绝

rows.gate_summary_zh: 拒绝 display 0 portrait 资格外的截图/tap/公开返回；不得向其他显示注入 input；fixture 与实机结果分开。
original_pass_postconditions: Screenshot/tap/public-return qualification rejects anything outside the qualified display 0 portrait geometry.
No input is injected on another display.
Fixture and physical-device outcomes remain separately labelled.
rows.title: 外屏或旋转：拒绝未资格显示配置

rows.gate_summary_zh: 准入后、dispatch 前断开自有测试传输；零 tool dispatch；原 claim 消耗；无自动新流/请求重放；未见原终态时保留 UNKNOWN；另补实际安装组合 physical_native_task。
original_pass_postconditions: No tool is dispatched and the accepted semantic identity remains consumed.
No automatic request/stream replay occurs.
No business success is emitted; unknown transport outcome remains unknown where no terminal is observed.
rows.title: 断连发生于dispatch之前

rows.gate_summary_zh: 作用开始后结果到达前断连；独立计数至多一次；未知不推成功、不重试；重连不能重用原身份；另补实机层。
original_pass_postconditions: Effect count is at most one.
Unknown result is not inferred as success and not retried.
A reconnect/new stream cannot reuse the semantic identity.
rows.title: 作用已开始后断连：保持未知且不重放

rows.gate_summary_zh: 隔离 HTTP model fixture 超时；原 fail frame 含 model_timeout；business=false、零 dispatch；原进程组/slot 有界收尾；无模型/账号 fallback、重启或 claim 释放。
original_pass_postconditions: Existing fail frame contains model_timeout; business_verified=false.
No tool dispatch, child process group leak, account/model fallback or relaunch occurs.
The claim remains consumed.
rows.title: 模型超时：有界结束且清理原进程组

rows.gate_summary_zh: 执行器结果超时；保留原 dispatch；迟到结果仅作证据，不改写原终态/UNKNOWN、不再执行；business=false、cleanup 明确；另补实机层。
original_pass_postconditions: No second effect is executed.
Late or unmatched results do not rewrite the accepted terminal/unknown outcome.
Business remains false and cancellation/cleanup state is explicit.
rows.title: 执行器结果超时：不能用迟到结果认定成功或再执行

rows.gate_summary_zh: 准入后首次 dispatch 前取消；保留 turn.cancelled 或丢失确认对应 UNKNOWN；零 phone 作用、无自动导航；business=false；原 HTTP-client 进程组确认收尾；另补实机层。
original_pass_postconditions: Existing turn.cancelled (or explicitly unknown transport outcome if the cancel acknowledgement is lost) is retained.
Zero phone effects; no automatic navigation on cancellation; business_verified=false.
No original HTTP-client process group remains after confirmed cleanup.
rows.title: dispatch前取消

rows.gate_summary_zh: 一次确认作用后取消；只保留已观察的一次作用，无后续 input/强制返回；不得宣称业务完成；不重放、不释放身份；另补实机层。
original_pass_postconditions: Exactly the already-observed effect remains; no follow-up input or forced return occurs.
Cancellation is not labelled complete business success.
No automatic replay or identity release occurs.
rows.title: 首次作用后取消

rows.gate_summary_zh: 独立新 fixture 分别拒绝图像预算不足、>120s 旧图、错误 call_id 和旧 round；在 dispatch 前拒绝；单图≤196608B、整 turn 图像≤393216B，不提额。
original_pass_postconditions: Each invalid condition fails before dispatch.
No budget extension, stale-image fallback or guessed generic tap occurs.
Maximum single image remains 196608 bytes and turn image budget 393216 bytes.
rows.title: 图片字节预算/过期图像/旧round绑定

rows.gate_summary_zh: 分别损坏 call_id、sequence、byte count、exit、truncation、Base64、source/hash；每项均拒收 image/text/return 事实，不能合成业务成功；fixture 明示 synthetic。
original_pass_postconditions: Each malformed envelope is rejected as insufficient evidence.
No image/text/return fact is admitted and no business success is synthesized.
Original test fixtures remain clearly labelled synthetic.
rows.title: native输出损坏/截断/错误身份

rows.gate_summary_zh: 只有 input helper receipt、缺公开回执/return/entire_request coverage 时，wire=turn.fail/business_not_verified，业务 sidecar 列缺项；native complete/model completed 不得覆盖缺项。
original_pass_postconditions: Existing wire kind is turn.fail with business_not_verified.
business-outcome.json lists missing conditions and business_verified=false.
Native complete or model summary cannot hide a missing app receipt/return/full-request coverage.
rows.title: 部分任务被模型说成完成：必须失败终态

rows.gate_summary_zh: 两个不同 semantic turns 竞争一个新 nonce/request：恰一次 O_EXCL 绑定；错误 scope 不消耗模板；已消耗模板不能再准入/dispatch；保留所有 claims/bindings。
original_pass_postconditions: Exactly one O_EXCL binding succeeds; wrong scope does not consume the template.
Consumed template cannot qualify or dispatch another task.
All claims/bindings remain; no deletion/reset to obtain a pass.
rows.title: 一次性模板并发/旧nonce重用

rows.gate_summary_zh: 仅识别的 enumerate→rename→lstat 临时名竞态可容忍；未知文件/I/O/canonical evidence 丢失须 fail closed；不为容量删 claim；已确认 worker/child/fd 收尾回到实测基线。
original_pass_postconditions: Only the exact recognized rename race is tolerated.
Unknown files/I/O failures fail closed; no accepted claim is deleted for capacity.
Confirmed worker/child/file-descriptor cleanup returns to the measured baseline.
rows.title: 容量/原子rename竞态与资源收尾
